_note: HOW MANY HINGES A DOOR NEEDS — the published Blum CLIP top table (turn 31, CLAUDE.md F6 check #4).
_why_this_file_exists: CLAUDE.md F6 #4 asks for 'weight (already computed) + height vs the Blum table
(reference/hardware/ — take the published CLIP top table; if the repo lacks it, add
it as a reference JSON with the source named)'. The repo had cliptop-hinges.json,
which is the ARTICLE list — which hinge, which plate, which finish — and says nothing
about how many of them a door takes. This is that second table.

_source.document: Blum Technical Handbook / CLIP top BLUMOTION catalogue — 'Number of hinges required' (door height × door weight)
_source.system: CLIP top / CLIP top BLUMOTION, overlay 110°
_honesty: These bands are TRANSCRIBED from Blum's published door-height / door-weight chart.
They are not measured by this workshop and they are not derived from anything in
this repository. Before this table is trusted on a heavy job it should be read back
against the current Blum catalogue for the exact system being fitted — Blum revises
the chart, and a 25 kg door is not a place to be approximately right.
The engine NEVER drills from this file: it is a CHECK, and check #4 warns. No hole
in this application comes from here (turn 31 iron rule 2).

_beyond_the_table.note: A door taller than 2400 or heavier than 24 kg is off the published chart. The check says so in those words rather than extrapolating a band Blum has not published.
